name: Cyberpunk Neon Noir
text: Cyberpunk neon noir aesthetic: drenched in glowing cyan and magenta neon signage, reflective wet asphalt pavements, moody volumetric rain haze, dark shadowy alleys, and atmospheric holographic reflections.

name: Cinematic Golden Hour
text: Cinematic golden hour lighting: warm ambient rim-lighting, soft diffused sun rays, natural 35mm film grain, gentle anamorphic lens flare, deep warm shadows, and shallow depth of field (f/1.8).

name: Rembrandt Studio Portrait
text: Professional studio portrait: dramatic Rembrandt triangle lighting on cheek, large softbox key light, subtle rim separation light, crisp specular catchlights in the eyes, neutral gray backdrop, 85mm lens sharpness.

name: Surrealist Dreamscape
text: Surrealist dreamscape inspired by Salvador Dali: impossible floating structures, ethereal translucent clouds, gravity-defying architecture, paradoxical perspectives, and a vast otherworldly twilight horizon.

name: Macro Botanical Nature
text: Ultra-detailed macro nature photography: f/2.8 shallow focus, glistening morning dew drops with microscopic reflections, intricate cellular leaf veins, soft creamy bokeh background, and gentle diffused morning light.

name: Japanese Ukiyo-e Woodblock
text: Traditional Japanese Ukiyo-e woodblock print: bold rhythmic black contour lines, organic paper texture with subtle woodgrain marks, flat decorative color fills in indigo and ochre, decorative cloud swirls.

name: Minimalist Bauhaus Architecture
text: Minimalist Bauhaus architectural composition: pure geometric forms, raw concrete and brushed steel materials, disciplined negative space, functional asymmetry, and sharp diagonal shadow casting.

name: Dark Fantasy Gothic
text: Dark gothic fantasy atmosphere: weathered stone gargoyles, ornate pointed arches, clinging thick ground mist, cold silver moonlight breaking through twisted dead branches, and haunting ancient majesty.

name: Retro 80s Synthwave
text: 1980s synthwave retrofuturism: glowing purple-pink laser wireframe grid receding to infinity, giant striped neon sunset on the horizon, polished chrome reflections, and vintage CRT scanline warmth.

name: Vaporwave Pastel Dream
text: Vaporwave aesthetic: serene pastel color palette of lilac, peach, and seafoam green, classical Roman marble sculpture fragments, nostalgic early 90s computer interface motifs, and hazy tropical sunset glow.

name: Baroque Chiaroscuro
text: Baroque chiaroscuro master painting style: profound tenebrism with pitch-black backgrounds, single intense directional beam of golden candlelight, rich impasto oil paint texture, and dramatic emotional tension.

name: Watercolor Impressionism
text: Loose watercolor impressionism: wet-on-wet pigment blooms, bleeding edges, luminous translucent color washes, expressive dry brush strokes, and authentic cold-press rough watercolor paper texture.

name: Clean Aerospace Sci-Fi
text: Clean pristine sci-fi aesthetics: matte white composite armor panels, subtle recessed blue LED seam illumination, ergonomic aerodynamic curves, carbon-fiber accents, and sterile aerospace laboratory cleanliness.

name: Vintage 1970s Polaroid
text: Authentic 1970s vintage instant photo: warm faded tones with yellow-green cast, soft lens corner vignetting, slight chemical film emulsion artifacts, characteristic nostalgic chromatic fringing, and tactile paper frame.

name: Steampunk Victorian Mechanical
text: Intricate steampunk Victorian machinery: burnished brass gears, coiled copper tubing, pressure gauges with glass faces, riveted cast iron structures, billowing plumes of white steam, and warm oil-lamp illumination.

name: Isometric 3D Clay Diorama
text: Charming isometric 3D miniature diorama: orthographic angle, smooth clay-like rounded surfaces, tilt-shift miniature depth-of-field effect, soft ambient studio lighting, and clean floating cubic pedestal.

name: Mythological Celestial Glow
text: Mythological celestial majesty: radiant divine god rays piercing heavenly clouds, glowing gold leaf accents, floating shimmering particle motes, shimmering bioluminescence, and timeless sacred grandeur.

name: Vintage Comic Pop Art
text: Vintage comic book pop art: high-contrast black ink brush outlines, visible Ben-Day halftone dot printing pattern, punchy primary CMYK print palette, dynamic action lines, and pulp paper print texture.

name: High Fashion Editorial
text: Avant-garde high fashion magazine editorial: striking dynamic pose, sculptural designer silhouette, sharp contrast flash photography with dark shadows, high saturation editorial color grading, and bold modern luxury.

name: Heavy Industrial Cybernetic Mech
text: Hard-surface heavy industrial mech: weathered olive and hazard-yellow matte armor plating, exposed hydraulic pistons and braided wiring harnesses, paint chipping, grease stains, and stencil technical warning decals.

name: Arctic Aurora Borealis
text: Arctic night sky spectacle: vivid curtains of emerald and amethyst aurora borealis undulating overhead, pristine snowdrifts casting pale reflections, mirror-calm dark fjord waters, and brilliant pin-prick stars.

name: Gritty Leica Street Photography
text: Henri Cartier-Bresson inspired street photography: high-contrast monochrome silver gelatin tones, capturing the decisive candid moment, crisp Leica 35mm optical fidelity, natural harsh sunlight and deep geometry.

name: Handmade Claymation Stop-Motion
text: Handcrafted stop-motion animation look: tangible polymer clay modeling with subtle thumbprints, physical miniature sets, warm tactile key lighting, shallow depth of field, and whimsical artisanal charm.

name: Technical Cyanotype Blueprint
text: Precision architectural cyanotype blueprint: deep Prussian blue background with razor-sharp crisp white technical drafting lines, dimensional annotations, grid markers, and cross-section schematics.

name: Deep Sea Abyssal Bioluminescence
text: Abyssal deep-sea ecosystem: pitch-black oceanic void illuminated by pulsating neon cyan and electric violet bioluminescent organism organs, translucent drifting jellyfish tendrils, and floating marine snow particles.

name: Anime Sky Art (Makoto Shinkai)
text: Makoto Shinkai inspired anime background art: colossal towering cumulus clouds lit by a setting sun, vivid gradient transitions from cobalt blue to blazing coral orange, lens flares, and emotional expansive sky.

name: Epic Panoramic Matte Painting
text: Cinematic fantasy concept matte painting: immense sweeping scale, atmospheric depth with misty mountain ridges fading into distance, golden sun shafts breaking through storm clouds, and detailed heroic composition.

name: Classic 1940s Film Noir
text: Classic 1940s film noir cinematography: harsh stark shadows cast through Venetian blinds across a smoke-filled office, high-contrast black-and-white tonal depth, rainy window silhouettes, and moody dramatic mood.

name: Luminous Gothic Stained Glass
text: Intricate Gothic cathedral stained-glass window: dark soldered lead ribbons binding glowing jewel-toned ruby, sapphire, and amber glass segments, with kaleidoscopic sunlight projecting vibrant colored patterns on ancient stone.

name: Stylized Low-Poly Geometric 3D
text: Stylized low-poly 3D art: faceted planar polygon surfaces, clean crisp polygonal edges, flat pastel lighting gradients, no textures, minimalist clean composition with soft ambient occlusion shadows.
